items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: For down to the chest, the Yesod of Ima Ila’a extends, and the Hassadim are covered, so there is no grip whatsoever for the Klipot [shells]. But from the chest downward, after the dominion of the Yesod of Ima has already ceased, the Hassadim there are revealed with the illumination of Hochma, and therefore corrections are needed so that there be no grip for the Klipot. (Inner Light, page 672, Sub Header, “Body”)
